parameters.name: AllowHoneypotAccessInternet
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to allow honeypots to access the Internet. Valid values:

*   **true**: allows honeypots to access the Internet.
*   **false**: does not allow honeypots to access the Internet.

parameters.name: NodeName
parameters.description: The name of the management node.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupProbeIpList
parameters.description: The CIDR blocks that are allowed to access the management node.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-honeypot-node --node-name manageNode --available-probe-num 20 --allow-honeypot-access-internet true --security-group-probe-ip-list 0.0.0.0/0 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateHoneypotNode --region cn-hangzhou --NodeName manageNode --SecurityGroupProbeIpList.1 '0.0.0.0/0' --AvailableProbeNum 20 --AllowHoneypotAccessInternet true
